scope.method: Exhaustive assignment of 704 non-OS inventory files, with bounded code/header reads and coverage checks of all 112 energy/crop/total-crop CSVs. File entries are unique; an asset may support multiple sheet rows. No study code executed or source data modified. Empty/header-only SWAT outputs are sidecars; current scientific run outputs are unmatched_data.

rows.evidence: Sixteen scenario CSVs directly contain Average_Energy_MW, Firm_Energy_MW and TotalSpills. Every file has 42 rows: six historical model/downscaling combinations and 36 future combinations. The matching KNN subset has three GCMs, two SSPs and three future climatologies. Discharge scenario files are identified as hydropower inputs by the workbook-generation code.
rows.limitations: The package also includes BCSD results outside the sheet KNN count. Land-management files use E0/E1/E2/E4 codes; final mapping to paper scenario names needs a lookup. Climatology codes 0-3 do not by themselves establish complete source periods: crop/discharge summaries start in 2000, and code boundaries use 2015/2045/2075. No full daily power time series was identified, but the described mean/firm-power outcomes are delivered.

No final sediment-retention or sediment-export scenario product was identified in the inventory. SDR_sed_export_statsTable_Chaglla.R reads and writes results in an author-specific external drive.
rows.limitations: This is a confirmed study/package association with related inputs and code; the requested derived asset remains absent. rows.evidence: Forty-one source NetCDFs are supplied: 38 GCM precipitation/temperature inputs plus three PISCO datasets, with selection/downscaling scripts and PISCO reports. Results/Climate data contains no non-OS files. No standalone set of 18 KNN future climatologies and four backcasts was located.
rows.limitations: Original GCM/PISCO inputs are not the downscaled product described. GCM names in the input package differ from the MIROC6/MPI result families. Prior metadata inspection flagged the PISCO precipitation time axis and a 20-year GFDL historical-temperature gap; assess these before reuse. Reproducing the outputs was outside this read-only matching review.

rows.evidence: Forty-eight CropYield CSVs plus 16 workbooks and 48 TotalCropYield CSVs plus 16 workbooks provide annual scenario crop yield and complementary total-production aggregates. All CSVs were checked for coverage: 2000-2014 historical and 2019-2099 future. Sample workbooks contain historical/ssp126/ssp585 sheets with the same model/downscaling columns. Landuse_analysis_library.R extracts SWAT HRU YLD, aggregates potato classes over selected Chaglla subbasins and exports annual results.
rows.limitations: The sheet period 1985-2014 is only partly delivered and future summaries stop in 2099, not 2100. The code includes POTA plus half-weighted POSE production; confirm agronomic meaning and reporting units. Both KNN and BCSD are present. XLSX/CSV formats overlap and should not be counted as independent datasets. These files do not deliver HRU-specific daily values.
